name: cognitive-consistency
description: d6e3a45 Core cognitive contracts: conflict-complete belief, context inclusion, half-open clocks, protected identity and portable numeric inputs.

cases.name: grounded conflict includes candidate diagnosis and visible slot opposition
slot conflict has no accepted values
LIMIT never hides a competing conflict
a multi-value preference slot remains accepted
scoped assertions cannot support context-free recall
exact context includes the matching scoped claim
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?a CONCEPT {name: "Ada"} ?b BELIEF (?a, "scoped", "work") } WITH EPISTEMIC {context_refs: ["C-2"]}

cases.name: a context-mismatched candidate is insufficient without exclusive completeness
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?a CONCEPT {name: "Ada"} ?b BELIEF (?a, "scoped", "travel") } WITH EPISTEMIC {context_refs: ["C-2"]}

cases.name: both explicit contexts disclose the conflict
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?a CONCEPT {name: "Ada"} ?b BELIEF (?a, "scoped", "work") } WITH EPISTEMIC {context_refs: ["C-2", "C-3"]}

cases.name: until is excluded exactly at the boundary: an expired value contributes nothing
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?a CONCEPT {name: "Ada"} ?b BELIEF (?a, "temporal", "old") } FOR TIME "2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: the value beginning at the boundary is eligible
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?a CONCEPT {name: "Ada"} ?b BELIEF (?a, "temporal", "new") } FOR TIME "2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: basis preserves canonical time and the next known invalidation
cases.command: FIND(?b.basis.valid_at, ?b.basis.next_invalid_at) WHERE { ?a CONCEPT {name: "Ada"} ?b BELIEF (?a, "temporal", "old") } FOR TIME "2026-09-06T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: invalid half-open interval ('2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z', '2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z')
cases.command: CREATE ASSERTION ?x { SET FIELDS { proposition: "P-7", asserted_by: "C-1", stance: "support", mode: "stated", valid_time: {"from": "2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z", "until": "2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z"} } }

cases.name: invalid half-open interval ('2026-09-08T00:00:00.000Z', '2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z')
cases.command: CREATE ASSERTION ?x { SET FIELDS { proposition: "P-7", asserted_by: "C-1", stance: "support", mode: "stated", valid_time: {"from": "2026-09-08T00:00:00.000Z", "until": "2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z"} } }
